title: Priority fastpath and safe rollback for hosted 5xx/timeouts during tenant escalations
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Implement a targeted prioritized fastpath and coordinated safe rollback process to mitigate hosted API 5xxs and timeouts observed during escalations from high-value tenants. This ticket covers triage runbook updates, an admission/fastpath shim at the edge, a conservative KV-cache compaction patch, rapid rollback gates, and customer comms templates. Goal: reduce P50/P95 latency spikes and limit 5xx blast radius while preserving correctness and avoiding retry amplification.
reproduction_steps: 1) Use staging with tenant-synthetics: replay production tenant CIDX traffic (provided in internal bucket)
2) Configure synthetic burst: 5x normal QPS for 30s with multipart streaming payloads to exercise streaming path
3) Toggle kvcache compaction flag off/on to surface eviction race under load
4) Observe edge admission behavior and apply fastpath header (X-RW-Priority:1) to force prioritized handling
5) Capture traces via /debug/trace and collect heap/epoll metrics from runtime nodes
decision_record: Adopt edge-priority-fastpath: lightweight token header that skips expensive long-poll queues for tickets flagged by SRE/Support
Implement KV-cache compaction conservative limiter (cap evictions to 5%/minute per shard) to avoid thrashing
Prefer staged rollback (runtime binary downgrade with blue/green routing) over config toggles for surface-area minimization
Do not change SDK retry defaults in this release; instead add server-side admission shaping to avoid client-triggered retry storms

test_plan: Unit tests for kvcache limiter logic (eviction cap enforcement)
Integration test: simulate tenant burst with and without fastpath header and assert latency and 5xx delta
Chaos test: induce slowdown on disk-backed nodes to validate graceful degradation and rollback behavior
Load test: 2 hour soak at 3x QPS in staging with telemetry capture
rollout_plan: 1) Merge PRs after final approvals and QA green
2) Deploy to canary region (us-west-2) with fastpath-gate=off and kvcache-limiter=on for 24h
3) Enable fastpath-gate=true for 10% of tenants (priority list) and monitor admission/drop/retry metrics for 48h
4) If metrics stable, expand to 50% then 100% across hosted clusters with 6-hour observation windows
5) If degradation detected, trigger automated staged rollback (see rollback_criteria) and open oncall bridge
rollback_criteria: Sustained increase in 5xx rate > 1.5x baseline for 30 minutes
Retry amplification metric > 1.2 for prioritized tenants
Admission drop rate > 5% for any single region
Unresolved customer-impacting errors reported by support within rollout window
